name: The Walt Disney Company
blurb: Disney is a global media and entertainment conglomerate whose assets span theme parks, film studios (Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Lucasfilm), the ABC broadcast network, ESPN, and the Disney+ and Hulu streaming platforms. The company has undergone significant restructuring under returning CEO Bob Iger, who returned in 2022 to stabilise the company after a turbulent period under his successor. Disney's streaming transition has been costly but Disney+ reached profitability in late 2024.
recent: Disney reported FY2025 revenue of approximately $93 billion. The experiences segment (theme parks and cruises) remains the primary profit engine. The company is pursuing ESPN's transition to a direct-to-consumer streaming service and has made moves to consolidate streaming assets. Paul Pelosi sold 10,000 shares of DIS per the January 2026 PTR disclosure.
